questions.question: When the Philistines heard that David had been anointed king over Israel, what did they do?

answers.text: They all went in search of him
They pulled back to their own land
They waited to see what he did

questions.question: When the Philistines spread out in the Valley of Rephaim, what did King David do?

answers.text: He asked the LORD what to do
He sent out a few spies

questions.question: When the Philistines again spread out in the Valley of Rephaim, what did the LORD tell David to do?
Before David's battle with the Philistines, God said the sound of marching in the treetops would mean what?

answers.text: The LORD had gone out before him
The Philistines were ready to retreat
His own men were all in place
